name: sentinel
description: HTTP security header scanner: web app, edge API, CLI and GitHub Action sharing one analysis engine.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sentinel/core && npm run build -w sentinel-scan && npm run build -w @sentinel/web && npm run build:root
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli --noEmit && tsc -p apps/worker --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
